36890-the-english-church-in-the-middle-a.title: The English Church In The Middle Ages
36890-the-english-church-in-the-middle-a.creator: Unknown
36890-the-english-church-in-the-middle-a.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. , and some gaps have therefore had to be filled up, and some links supplied. This has been done as far as possible by notices of matters which bear on the moral condition of the Church, and serve to show how far it was qualified at various periods to be the example and instructor of the nation.

arxiv-1512-00601.title: Balanced Metric and Berezin Quantization on the Siegel–Jacobi Ball
arxiv-1512-00601.creator: Stefan BERCEANU
arxiv-1512-00601.description: Abstract We determine the matrix of the balanced metric of the Siegel–Jacobi ball and its inverse. We calculate the scalar curvature, the Ricci form and the Laplace–Beltrami operator of this manifold. We discuss several geometric aspects related with Berezin quantization on the Siegel–Jacobi ball.

arxiv-2306-02614.title: Two interacting conformal Carroll particles
arxiv-2306-02614.creator: Roberto Casalbuoni a), Daniele Dominici a), Joaquim Gomis b)
arxiv-2306-02614.description: Abstract In this note we analyse two different models of two interacting conformal Carroll particles that can be obtained as the Carrollian limit of two relativistic conformal particles. The first model describes particles with zero velocity and exhibits infinite dimensional symmetries which are reminiscent of the BMS symmetries.

arxiv-2307-16070.title: Spin-Induced Interactions and Heavy-Quark Transport in the QGP
arxiv-2307-16070.creator: Ralf Rapp
arxiv-2307-16070.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ralf Rapp. A previously constructed T T -matrix approach for studying the quark-gluon plasma (QGP) is improved by incorporating spin-dependent interactions between partons. These interactions arise from the relativistic corrections to the Cornell potential. We first study the vacuum spectroscopy of quarkonia with this potential and find that a significant admixture of a vector component in the confining potential (rather than the previously considered scalar interaction) improves the description of the experimental mass splittings in S S - and P P -wave states.

arxiv-2407-13382.title: Open-World Visual Reasoning by a Neuro-Symbolic Program of Zero-Shot Symbols Thanks: Supported by TNO ERP APPL.AI program.
arxiv-2407-13382.creator: G.J. Burghouts, F. Hillerström, E. Walraven, M. van Bekkum, F. Ruis, J. Sijs, J. van Mil, J. Dijk, W. Meijer
arxiv-2407-13382.description: Abstract We consider the problem of finding spatial configurations of multiple objects in images, e.g., a mobile inspection robot is tasked to localize abandoned tools on the floor. We define the spatial configuration of objects by first-order logic in terms of relations and attributes.

arxiv-2410-16910.title: TreeDiffusion: Hierarchical Generative Clustering for Conditional Diffusion
arxiv-2410-16910.creator: Jorge da Silva Gonçalves (✉), Laura Manduchi, Moritz Vandenhirtz, Julia E. Vogt
arxiv-2410-16910.description: Abstract Generative modeling and clustering are conventionally distinct tasks in machine learning. Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) have been widely explored for their ability to integrate both, providing a framework for generative clustering. However, while VAEs can learn meaningful cluster representations in latent space, they often struggle to generate high-quality samples.

arxiv-2501-18506.title: Design and Validation of Learning Aware HMI For Learning-Enabled Increasingly Autonomous Systems* Thanks: *We would like to thank Nandith Narayan for his initial support in setting up the infrastructure for LEIAS. This work was funded by award 80NSSC20M0005 to the NASA Langley Research Center from t
arxiv-2501-18506.creator: Parth Ganeriwala, Michael Matessa, Siddhartha Bhattacharyya, Randolph M. Jones, Jennifer Davis, Parneet Kaur, Simone Fulvio Rollini, Natasha Neogi
arxiv-2501-18506.description: Abstract With the rapid advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI), autonomous agents are increasingly expected to manage complex situations where learning-enabled algorithms are vital. However, the integration of these advanced algorithms poses significant challenges, especially concerning safety and reliability. This research emphasizes the importance of incorporating human-machine collaboration into the systems engineering process to design learning-enabled increasingly autonomous systems (LEIAS).

arxiv-2502-11928.title: Exploring the BSM parameter space with Neural Network aided Simulation-Based Inference
arxiv-2502-11928.creator: Atrideb Chatterjee, Arghya Choudhury, Sourav Mitra, Arpita Mondal, and Subhadeep Mondal
arxiv-2502-11928.description: Abstract Some of the issues that make sampling parameter spaces of various beyond the Standard Model (BSM) scenarios computationally expensive are the high dimensionality of the input parameter space, complex likelihoods, and stringent experimental constraints. In this work, we explore likelihood-free approaches, leveraging neural network-aided Simulation-Based Inference (SBI) to alleviate this issue.

arxiv-2502-14479.title: Modelling the term-structure of default risk under IFRS 9 within a multistate regression framework
arxiv-2502-14479.creator: Arno Botha, Tanja Verster, Roland Breedt
arxiv-2502-14479.description: Abstract The lifetime behaviour of loans is notoriously difficult to model, which can compromise a bank’s financial reserves against future losses, if modelled poorly. Therefore, we present a data-driven comparative study amongst three techniques in modelling a series of default risk estimates over the lifetime of each loan, i.e., its term-structure.

arxiv-2503-03607.title: Psy-Insight: Explainable Multi-turn Bilingual Dataset for Mental Health Counseling
arxiv-2503-03607.creator: Keqi Chen, Zekai Sun, Yuhua Wen, Huijun Lian, Yingming Gao, Ya Li
arxiv-2503-03607.description: Abstract The in-context learning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) show great potential in mental health support. However, the lack of counseling datasets, particularly in Chinese corpora, restricts their application in this field. To address this, we constructed Psy-Insight, the first mental health-oriented explainable multi-task bilingual dataset.

arxiv-2507-06042.title: On Lockean beliefs that are deductively closed and minimal change
arxiv-2507-06042.creator: Tommaso Flaminio, Lluis Godo, Ramón Pino Pérez, Lluis Subirana
arxiv-2507-06042.description: Abstract Within the formal setting of the Lockean thesis, an agent belief set is defined in terms of degrees of confidence and these are described in probabilistic terms. This approach is of established interest, notwithstanding some limitations that make its use troublesome in some contexts, like, for instance, in belief change theory.

arxiv-2511-04940.title: Strategic Decision-Making Under Uncertainty through Bi-Level Game Theory and Distributionally Robust Optimization
arxiv-2511-04940.creator: Jiachen Shen, Jian Shi, Lei Fan, Chenye Wu, Dan Wang, Choong Seon Hong, Zhu Han
arxiv-2511-04940.description: Abstract In strategic scenarios where decision-makers operate at different hierarchical levels, traditional optimization methods are often inadequate for handling uncertainties from incomplete information or unpredictable external factors. To fill this gap, we introduce a mathematical framework that integrates bi-level game theory with distributionally robust optimization (DRO), particularly suited for complex network systems.

plos-pone-0007797.creator: Mariangela Chisari, Deepak Kumar Saini, Joon-Ho Cho et al.
plos-pone-0007797.description: PLOS ONE research article. We examined the role of G proteins in modulating the response of living cells to receptor activation. The response of an effector, phospholipase C-β to M3 muscarinic receptor activation was measured using sensors that detect the generation of inositol triphosphate or diacylglycer

pmc-10650283.title: Rapid Identification of High-Temperature Responsive Genes Using Large-Scale Yeast Functional Screening System in Potato
pmc-10650283.creator: Ke Wang, Shiqi Wen, Lina Shang, Yang Li, Ziyan Li, Weixi Chen, Yong Li, Hongju Jian, Dianqiu Lyu
pmc-10650283.description: As the third largest global food crop, potato plays an important role in ensuring food security. However, it is particularly sensitive to high temperatures, which seriously inhibits its growth and development, thereby reducing yield and quality and severely limiting its planting area.

pmc-11353943.title: Prognostic Implication of Ventricular Volumetry in Early Brain Computed Tomography after Cardiac Arrest
pmc-11353943.creator: Ae Kyung Gong, Sang Hoon Oh, Jinhee Jang, Kyu Nam Park, Han Joon Kim, Ji Young Lee, Chun Song Youn, Jee Yong Lim, Hyo Joon Kim, Hyo Jin Bang, Fabio Sandomenico
pmc-11353943.description: Brain swelling after cardiac arrest may affect brain ventricular volume. This study aimed to investigate the prognostic implications of ventricular volume on early thin-slice brain computed tomography (CT) after cardiac arrest. We measured the gray-to-white matter ratio (GWR) and the characteristics and volumes of the lateral, third, and fourth ventricles. The primary outcome was a poor 6-month neurological outcome.

pmc-11428669.title: A 3D Epithelial–Mesenchymal Co-Culture Model of the Airway Wall Using Native Lung Extracellular Matrix
pmc-11428669.creator: Roderick H. J. de Hilster, Marjan A. Reinders-Luinge, Annemarie Schuil, Theo Borghuis, Martin C. Harmsen, Janette K. Burgess, Machteld N. Hylkema
pmc-11428669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a chronic lung disease characterized by ongoing inflammation, impaired tissue repair, and aberrant interplay between airway epithelium and fibroblasts, resulting in an altered extracellular matrix (ECM) composition. The ECM is the three-dimensional (3D) scaffold that provides mechanical support and biochemical signals to cells, now recognized not only as a consequence but as a potential driver of disease progression.

pmc-11529359.title: Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction in Tibial Eminence Avulsion Fracture: A Case Series
pmc-11529359.creator: Armansyah Nur Dewantara, I Gusti Ngurah Wien Aryana, Febyan
pmc-11529359.description: Introduction:Ruptures of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) are common orthopaedic injuries, especially among patients participating in sports. Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) avulsion fracture or tibial eminence avulsion fracture is a type of avulsion fracture of the knee. This article describes several cases of ACL rupture management with eminentia avulsion.

pmc-11690893.title: VARIATION IN STATE APPROACHES TO DEMENTIA CARE TRAINING IN ASSISTED LIVING
pmc-11690893.creator: Paula Carder, Lindsey Smith, Sarah Dys, Eric Jutkowitz, Kali Thomas
pmc-11690893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Assisted living (AL) communities increasingly serve individuals with Alzheimer’s disease and related disorders (ADRD); an estimated 50% of AL residents have ADRD, and more AL have designated memory care than do nursing homes. State AL regulations vary on almost every provision that affects resident safety and quality, including staffing levels, building design, safety features, admission and discharge criteria, and social-recreational programming. Nearly every state requires that direct care workers receive training in dementia care.

pmc-12622613.title: A retrospective study on the correlation between serum MHR, NLR and recurrence of coronary events after coronary stent implantation in elderly patients
pmc-12622613.creator: Chunxiao Zhang, Sai Wang
pmc-12622613.description: This study analyzes the recurrence of coronary events and their relationship with the monocyte to high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio (MHR) and neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio (NLR) in elderly patients with coronary stent implantation. A retrospective analysis was performed on 136 cases elderly patients who received coronary stent implantation in ShengLi Oil Field Central Hospital from December 2019 to June 2023.

pmc-12705653.title: Nonconventional near-infrared room-temperature phosphorescent materials based on spiropolymer alloy
pmc-12705653.creator: Yue Ren, Yongfeng Zhang, Han Su, Yeyun Zhao, Wenya Yan, Wenbo Dai, Luojie Zhu, Tao Wang, Jianbing Shi, Junge Zhi, Bin Tong, Peng Sun, Zhengxu Cai, Yuping Dong
pmc-12705653.description: Near-infrared room-temperature phosphorescent (NIR-RTP) materials feature the advantages of large Stokes shift, long emission lifetime, and high penetration ability, and have been broadly applied in bio-medical imaging, fiber optic telecommunication, and night vision-readable display. Developing organic NIR-RTP materials heavily relies on the long-conjugated chemical structures.

pmc-12784661.title: High Doses of Norfloxacin Nicotinate Induce Apoptosis, Developmental Neurotoxicity, and Aberrant DNA Methylation in Zebrafish (Danio rerio) Larvae
pmc-12784661.creator: Hansun Fang, Runping Wang, Fang Wang, Kaibin Li, Huili Liang, Tian Su, Lili Wei, Jiming Ruan, Fugui Li, Ximei Liang
pmc-12784661.description: Simple SummaryNorfloxacin nicotinate (NOR-N), a derivative and effective substitute of norfloxacin (NOR), has been widely used in livestock production and aquaculture sectors. However, the adverse impacts of NOR-N on non-target animals and their associated biological response mechanisms are still not completely elucidated.

pmc-13230185.title: Herbal medicine as a complementary therapy for dysmenorrhea: effects on pain and reduction of analgesic use
pmc-13230185.creator: Soo-Hyun Sung, Kyeore Bae, Hyein Jeong, Dong-Il Kim, Minjung Park
pmc-13230185.description: ObjectiveDysmenorrhea is a prevalent gynecological disorder impairing quality of life for women of reproductive age. Although traditional herbal decoctions (THDs) are widely used for dysmenorrhea in Korea, robust real-world evidence regarding their clinical outcomes and safety is limited. This descriptive, hypothesis-generating registry study aimed to examine individualized THDs for dysmenorrhea using registry data from a multicenter observational study.

pmc-13265684.title: The miR-212-3p/transferrin axis promotes bone regeneration by modulating iron homeostasis through Schwann cell Exosome-BMSCs communication
pmc-13265684.creator: Yukun Jia, Ningdao Li, Dagang Tang, Wendan Pu, Zhiqiang Feng, Yingtao Duan, Yafei Zhu, Juan Wang, Xiaoji Luo, Jun Zhang
pmc-13265684.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Functional bone regeneration relies on cross talk between nerves and bone, yet the regulatory mechanisms linking Schwann cells (SCs) to osteoporotic bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (OP-BMSCs) remain unclear. This study demonstrated that SC-Exosomes (Exos) promoted the osteogenic differentiation of OP-BMSCs, and miRNA-mRNA sequencing revealed that SC-Exos, which contained the key mediator miR-212-3p, facilitated osteogenesis by suppressing the ferroptosis pathway in OP-BMSCs.

pmc-13294200.title: Quantifying telomere length: from bulk assays to single-molecule resolution
pmc-13294200.creator: Kangkang Ma, Zhongbo Yu
pmc-13294200.description: Telomere length (TL) is a promising biomarker for age-associated diseases and cancer. Single-molecule studies of human TL are advancing rapidly, providing unprecedented insights into the dynamics and variability of telomeres at the single-molecule level. TL is commonly reported as average TL or relative TL, depending on the methods used.

pmc-13377158.title: Health Care Use and Outcomes in Heart Failure
pmc-13377158.creator: Finlay A. McAlister, Chuan Wen, Jeffrey A. Bakal, Mohit Bhutani, Michael K. Stickland, Paul E. Ronksley, Jason Weatherald, Grace Y. Lam
pmc-13377158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13430129.title: A Metabolomic Signature Predicts Gout Flare Clinical Outcome Associated With Colchicine Prophylaxis
pmc-13430129.creator: Wenyan Sun, Lingfang Xu, Haibing Chen, Mingshu Sun, Zhiqiang Li, Rui Li, Lidan Ma, Hui Zhang, Aichang Ji, Yuwei He, Na Wu, Le Yan, Robert Terkeltaub, Changgui Li
pmc-13430129.description: ObjectiveThis study investigated that serum metabolomics, before urate‐lowering therapy (ULT) initiation, could serve as a biomarker for responsiveness to colchicine prophylaxis in patients with gout commencing treat‐to‐target ULT.MethodsWe studied a multicenter prospective cohort (n = 409) initiating treat‐to‐target ULT plus colchicine prophylaxis. Untargeted metabolomics were measured at enrollment.

pmc-13435478.title: The Arabic nasal obstruction symptom evaluation scale (Arabic NOSE): validation and severity categorization in Middle Eastern population
pmc-13435478.creator: Turki Aldrees, Basil Hassouneh, Zaid Almubarak, Saad Alsaleh
pmc-13435478.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to adapt the NOSE instrument into the Arabic language using a cohort that reflects the linguistic and cultural diversity of Middle Eastern nationalities and dialects. Additionally, the study aimed to evaluate score distribution and propose a preliminary severity categorization using a Middle Eastern cohort.

pmc-13670444.title: Multimodal non-surgical management of isolated tracheobronchial mucormycosis: a case series of 8 patients
pmc-13670444.creator: Zeqin Fan, Liqiong Liu, Na Yang, Mengli Li, Panpan Qian, Shuanglan Xu, Xiqian Xing
pmc-13670444.description: BackgroundIsolated tracheobronchial mucormycosis (ITBM), a distinct subtype of pulmonary mucormycosis (PM), is a relatively rare but life-threatening infection. Here, we present our experience in the multimodal comprehensive treatment of ITBM.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective descriptive case series of ITBM patients at the Affiliated Hospital of Yunnan University from 2020 to 2023.

pmc-13681800.title: Patient perspective regarding the role of social media, offline reputation, and practitioner characteristics in orthodontist selection: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13681800.creator: Prangrath Liengjohor, Saranya Serirukchutarungsee, Neeranart Thirasupa
pmc-13681800.description: BackgroundDeterminants of orthodontist selection in the modern era remain inconsistent, especially roles of online versus traditional factors. This study compared social media, offline reputation, and orthodontist characteristics associated with orthodontist selection.MethodsThis cross-sectional analytical study was conducted among 330 working-age adults seeking orthodontic treatment (mean age 29.9 ± 3.3 years).

uslaw-usc-t40-s1305.title: 40 U.S.C. § 1305 — Disposition of land acquired by devise
uslaw-usc-t40-s1305.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s1305.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Chapter 13 (Public Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The General Services Administration may take custody, for disposal as excess property under this subtitle and division C (except sections 3302, 3501(b), 3509, 3906, 4710, and 4711) of subtitle I of title 41, of land acquired by the Federal Government by devise.
